notes: Spec § U-ALL09 cron schedule for the auto-learning loop. All cadences use off-minute timings (per CLAUDE.md cron discipline §6c: avoid :00 and :30 so fleet-wide cron pulses don't collide). Operator activates via Windows Task Scheduler / systemd / equivalent — this file is the contract the future activation script (deferred to U-ALL09 cron landing) reads.

entries.cadence_description: Every 4 hours, on the 7th minute — polls all reputable sources for new items.
Every 30 minutes — detect novelty in pending source-monitor catches; commit verified-novel items.
Hourly at minute 13 — flush pending novel items through the rate-limited researcher dispatcher.
Every 15 minutes — classify completed researcher outputs into high/med/low/none synergy bands.
Hourly at minute 27 — emit augmentation document for high/med synergy classifications.
Daily at 09:03 local — push digest of pending high-synergy roadmap proposals to user + chat-bus.

adversarial_handling.cron_overlap: Each entry must acquire a per-entry file-lock (state/shared/auto-learning/.locks/<id>.lock) before running; lock is released on exit. Default lock-wait is 0 (skip this tick).
adversarial_handling.dst_drift: All cadences interpreted in UTC by the cron daemon — operator-side scheduler MUST be configured to UTC, not local time.
adversarial_handling.cron_service_down: systemd watchdog (Linux) / Windows Task Scheduler retry on next interval
